authorization: authorization.json current direct user approval to execute full CSV on server
prior_campaigns: read-only sources; no old holdout or D_test in tuning/confirmation

system.interleaver: identity, current code convention; no random extra interleaver
system.prior400: frozen; B0/no-repair families do not consume it; A2 identity must hash actual file

power.record_actual: norm(pilot_scaled+data_scaled)^2/N and cross term; do not renormalize individual frames

timing.role: isolated deployment timing, no performance selection

rng.frame_key: namespace + split + block + component; SNR deliberately absent to pair normalized noise across SNR
rng.code_interleaver: code fixed seed/hash, identity interleaver; independent namespace reserved but not used to change frozen code

design.resolution_of_source_conflict: eight TOTAL configurations, not 8x5 families; 192x8x1SNR=1536 full calls
design.parameter_rationale: size1 is conventional BIC; ridge/SBL logarithmic-grid middle; identical scale options for every family; not chosen from old holdout
design.selection: coded FER/isolated latency Pareto; default lowest FER within cost; if paired interval cannot separate top cost-class contenders retain top two for confirmation; no inference from a single point

factorial.sigma: each block uses frozen B_star terminal sigma value multiplied by its frozen terminal scale across ALL eight cells
factorial.normal_output: B_star own final output logged separately
factorial.detector_reference: pre-fixed high-compute soft detector validated in DET-01 before mechanism; no reference tuning on mechanism
contrasts_at_8dB: detector effect within each of four H cells
factorial.uncertainty: paired per-block contrasts; FER differences use Bonferroni-adjusted exact marginal binomial bounds; interaction uses pre-fixed paired-block bootstrap20000 with family-adjusted percentile intervals, exploratory only; zero-degenerate intervals not equivalence

statistics.primary_interval: conservative exact paired win/loss: lower=CP_lower(wins,n,alpha/2)-CP_upper(losses,n,alpha/2); no independence between wins/losses assumed, union bound; upper analog
statistics.neighbor_rule: at each7/9dB, lower bound of delta > -0.01 using one-sided family0.05 Bonferroni alpha0.025 per endpoint; insufficient width/zero cells recorded as bounds not equivalence
statistics.sample_size: source normal approx first; account conservative interval width in final n freeze; if >4096/approved cost then resource STOP, never add to significance
statistics.alternative_equivalence_objective: not selected; cannot switch after seeing confirmation

priority: first correct dominant detector/cancellation classical baseline
M if mapping-underused and structural oracle budget gate passes
I-feedback or I-cancel only if structure unsuitable or relevant interface dominates
STOP if no sufficient realizable case
route_rules.oracle_resource_gate: 8dB point delta>=0.05 and7/9 point directions nonnegative; exploration allocation only; no precision rescue sampling
route_rules.cancellation_gate: BP cancellation-only delta>=0.05 and family-adjusted lower>0; same frozen sigma already used so oracle relief tests error not free scalar tuning
route_rules.detector_dominance: same H detector effect delta>=0.05, family lower>0, and point gain exceeds max(cancel-only,data-only) by>=0.01;7/9 no point reversal
route_rules.tie: choose higher effect per measured full cost; if within0.01 prefer M then I-cancel then I-feedback; never concatenate branches
route_rules.precision_insufficient: record uncertain and no automatic expansion; route is resource decision only
route_rules.baseline_correction: append explicit implementation/validation issue before candidate comparison; freeze only from independent design data, register all additional costs

budget.phase_costs: NF*cF+NT*cT+NE*cE + source/test/independent audit/prior/transfer overhead; failures count; reserve before launch
budget.fit_policy: microcost first, shrink shared development/non-loadbearing scenes if needed, preserve main confirm precision or decline confirmation
budget.parallel: up to2 GPU workers after microcost/memory checks, separate CPU affinity groups4 cores, BLAS threads1; isolated timing single worker no GPU overlap

cost_gate.pass: block-bootstrap upper bound of each mean/p95 ratio<=1.1; overlap inconclusive
cost_gate.timer_original: device-ready y to decoded bits including final BP/LLR/LDPC; simulation and logging excluded
cost_gate.additional_costs: transfer/init reported separately and end-to-end inclusive report provided
cost_gate.A2_unavailable: gate unverified; do not replace denominator

final_action: one decision from source§13, not many possibilities; honest no-effect vs low-power vs resource-stop; project claims/pivot require user acceptance
